changes: Official validate, done_required_validate, and derived review binding now share one canonical workspace validation capacity with safe queueing, diagnostics, reentrancy, and recovery.
usage: Run official Lattice validation commands normally; concurrent official validations wait and then continue automatically. Bare npm test remains outside the lease and must be scheduled separately.
expectedOutcome: Different stories and linked worktrees cannot enter official validation critical sections concurrently, while users receive bounded wait diagnostics and eventual execution.
actualTranscript: Focused capacity smoke passed 15 assertion groups, full lock smoke passed 26 groups, 29 of 29 verification intents are current, configured validate passed 96 of 96 commands, and DONE-required root npm test passed 47 of 47 members.
outcomeDiff: No functional gap remains between expected and observed behavior; the only operational recovery encountered was rebuilding ignored dist artifacts after a test removed them.
limitations: Bare npm test is intentionally not protected by the workspace lease; a crash before private queue publication may leave a nonblocking ignored preparing directory.
pitfalls: Do not parallelize official validation to bypass the gate and do not add ad hoc timeout environment variables to formal validate or DONE-required evidence commands.
